issues.issue: Mixed line: the dominant part (35,746 in the CDBG Fund, shown on p2 as an operating grant for economic development) is a CDBG grant, i.e. federal grants / intergovernmental, not private donations. The mixed-line rule calls for the dominant category (federal grants) plus review; the extractor took the minority part (11,945 contributions).

Governmental beginning/ending cash are taken from the fund balance figures (modified cash basis). Ending fund balance 533,203 equals governmental cash and CDs 543,360 (p4) less payroll taxes withheld 10,157, so this is not pure cash. It is noted and marked computed, but it is still an assumption.
